result:
Confirmado el patrón existente en el mismo archivo (líneas 211 y 238) que castea `extraKnownMarketplaces` a `Record<string, DeclaredMarketplace>` porque el campo no está en el schema tipado de `Settings` (queda bajo `.passthrough()`, sin firma de índice). Aplico la misma solución aquí.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/config/plugin/marketplaceManager.ts",
 "edits": [{"old": "    // Remove from extraKnownMarketplaces if present
    if (settings.extraKnownMarketplaces?.[name]) {
      const updatedMarketplaces: Partial<
        SettingsJson['extraKnownMarketplaces']
      > = { ...settings.extraKnownMarketplaces }
      // Use undefined values (NOT delete) to signal key removal via mergeWith
      updatedMarketplaces[name] = undefined
      updates.extraKnownMarketplaces =
        updatedMarketplaces as SettingsJson['extraKnownMarketplaces']
      needsUpdate = true
    }",
             "new": "    // Remove from extraKnownMarketplaces if present
    const extraKnownMarketplaces = settings.extraKnownMarketplaces as
      | Record<string, DeclaredMarketplace>
      | undefined
    if (extraKnownMarketplaces?.[name]) {
      const updatedMarketplaces: Partial<Record<string, DeclaredMarketplace>> =
        { ...extraKnownMarketplaces }
      // Use undefined values (NOT delete) to signal key removal via mergeWith
      updatedMarketplaces[name] = undefined
      updates.extraKnownMarketplaces =
        updatedMarketplaces as SettingsJson['extraKnownMarketplaces']
      needsUpdate = true
    }"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "passthrough-settings-field-needs-record-cast",
               "senal_del_verificador": "TS7053.*(type '\{\}'|type 'Partial<unknown>')",
               "fix_generico": "Cuando un campo de `SettingsJson` no está declarado en el schema tipado (queda cubierto por `.passthrough()` de zod, sin firma de índice), no se indexa directo sobre `settings.<campo>`: se castea primero a `Record<string, TipoDelValor> | undefined` en una variable local, y esa variable —no la propiedad sin castear— es la que se indexa y se spread. El tipo del valor (`TipoDelValor`) sale de la interfaz local ya usada para ese campo en el resto del módulo (aquí, `DeclaredMarketplace`), nunca de `any`.",
               "edits": [0]}],
 "fixes": ["src/packages/config/plugin/marketplaceManager.ts(1994,9): error TS7053: Element implicitly has an 'any' type because expression of type 'string' can't be used to index type '{}'.",
           "src/packages/config/plugin/marketplaceManager.ts(1999,7): error TS7053: Element implicitly has an 'any' type because expression of type 'string' can't be used to index type 'Partial<unknown>'."],
 "skipped": []}
```
